name: usage-bar
description: Usage limits, context and cost above the prompt; keeps your status line

warnCold.title: Show cache cold
warnCold.description: Show a red "cache cold" on the line once the prompt cache has expired, so you know your next message re-reads the whole conversation at full price.

coldTokens.title: Cache cold from (tokens)
coldTokens.description: Show "cache cold" only when the conversation has at least this many tokens; below it, re-reading costs little.
